scope: Descriptive check of the original no-removal accounts at 10% proceeds haircut. Compare gross modeled sale USD with the same participation fraction of economic volume in the 60 seconds ending five seconds before the modeled sale. This is an exit-time diagnostic, never a future-dependent entry filter. No return is recomputed or claimed executable. Empty or missing sale capacity is explicit; zero-recovery sales are separate. Fee comparisons use the prior exit-pool gas/MEV median against one half of the modeled round-trip fee.
